`
xx = self.communicate("""echo \"{}\" > /root/state.json""", check="raise", timeout=self.post_startup_command_timeout)
yy = self.communicate("""cat /root/state.json""")
`

comments.author: HFadeel
comments.body:
A potential bug fix is removing the Path() from _env.read_file().

before (tools.py _get_state)
```state_str = env.read_file(Path("/root/state.json"))```

after
``state_str = env.read_file("/root/state.json")```

please confirm

Please add your full command line call and the full log up until the (firrst) traceback
